posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Hello Peoples!

I was just googling my usual username "matchstickman" and came across this thread, why are you all talking about me?

I only just found out about Sentinels of the Multiverse a few days ago, a huge box of stuff just arrived at my door with no warning, just a piece of paper with this website address and my perfered username written on it. Strangely enough, when I decided to try logging into that account I tried my usual password and it worked!

Anyway, I look forward to "meeting" you all and learning more about Sentinels.

Let's save that Multiverse!
